description: Source code for a network simulation framework in Python, including classes for events, algorithms, and simulation management, specifically designed for simulating multi-AP network scenarios with time-based events and message passing.

classes.name: Tick
classes.description: A unit of time measured in simulator ticks (100us), with methods for string representation and creation from seconds.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a scheduled event in the simulation, triggered at a specific tick with an associated callback.

classes.name: Algorithm
classes.description: Base class for algorithms that run on devices within the simulation, providing lifecycle hooks and message handling.

classes.name: Simulation
classes.description: Manages execution of scheduled events, algorithms, and message passing in the network simulation.

methods.name: None add_event(self, when: Union[Tick, int], callback: Callable[[Tick, Network], None], description: str = "Event")
methods.description: Schedules a new event at a specific simulation tick.

methods.name: None add_algorithm_to_device(self, algorithm: Algorithm, device: Device)
methods.description: Associates an algorithm with a specific device within the simulation.

methods.name: None run(self, checker: Callable[[Tick, Network, Any], None])
methods.description: Executes the simulation by processing scheduled events in chronological order.

methods.name: __init__(self, when: Union[Tick, int], callback: Callable[[Tick, Any], None], description: Any = "Event")
forward_msg(message: Message, src: Device, dst: Optional[Device], on_device: Device, src_link: Optional[Link], simulation: Simulation)
handle_message(self, when: Tick, device: Device, message: Message, src: Device, dst: Optional[Device], src_link: Optional[Link])
send_msg(message: Message, src: Device, dst: Optional[Device], simulation: Simulation)
None set_start(self, when: Tick, device: Device)
None set_timeout(self, when: Union[Tick, int], device: Device, callback: Callable[[Tick, Device, Any], None], description: Any = None)
